correctness.rationale: The Fano triple graph is exactly enumerated (28 vertices, 42 edges, girth seven, diameter four). At radius three all 10,896 nonempty cliques are recursively generated without cutoff. A deterministic 5,404-pair discrete-Morse matching has one critical zero-cell and 87 critical four-cells, and exhaustive orientation of all 48,916 face incidences is a DAG (10,896 topological-sort visits). This proves an integral 87-S4 wedge. Independent mod-two boundary ranks agree, radius two collapses by Adamaszek Proposition 2.2 and explicit tetrahedron relative collapses, radius four is a simplex, so all-field barcode follows. Limits: no general graph-family theorem.

value.rationale: A natural complete invariant of a canonical 28-vertex distance-transitive, girth-seven, diameter-four graph: its graph-metric Rips topology jumps from 15 persistent circles to 87 four-spheres at the first radius not governed by the classic girth stability theorem. The exact four-dimensional sphere multiplicity and complete integral/field-independent barcode have intrinsic relevance for graph powers, metric flag complexes and finite topological persistence; it is not a routine radius-two corollary or an arbitrary parameter slice. No larger-family or downstream theorem is asserted.
